sentences.ar: كان الضباب تقيل، والقمر لسا ما طلع.
sentences.en: The fog was thick, and the moon had not yet risen.

sentences.ar: ركضنا لحد الجسر الزغير، وأمي قالت: ما بقدر أكمل.
sentences.en: We ran as far as the little bridge, and my mother said: I cannot go on.

sentences.ar: وقعت جنب الجسر، وأنا سحبتها تحته.
sentences.en: She collapsed beside the bridge, and I dragged her under it.

sentences.ar: كنا قريبين من النزل، نسمع كل إشي ونشوف.
sentences.en: We were close to the inn, hearing and seeing everything.

sentences.ar: وشفت سبعة أو تمانية رجال جايين بالركض، والأعمى بالنص.
sentences.en: And I saw seven or eight men coming at a run, with the blind man in the middle.
The blind man was shouting: break the door down!

sentences.ar: كسروا الباب، وفاتوا، وسمعنا صوتهم من جوا.
sentences.en: They broke the door, went in, and we heard their voices from inside.
One shouted: Bill is dead!
The blind man shouted: search him!
And go up to the chest!

sentences.ar: وبعد شوي، صرخ واحد من الشباك: حدا فتح الصندوق قبلنا!
sentences.en: And a little later, one shouted from the window: someone opened the chest before us!
The blind man said: is the money there?

sentences.ar: قال: المصاري موجودة، بس أوراق فلينت مش موجودة.
sentences.en: He said: the money is there, but Flint's papers are not.
The blind man screamed: the boy!
The boy took them!
Look for him!

sentences.ar: صاروا يدوروا بكل مكان، ويكسروا كل إشي.
sentences.en: They began searching everywhere, breaking everything.
And I was under the bridge, not breathing.

sentences.ar: وبعدين سمعنا صفير من فوق التلة.
sentences.en: And then we heard a whistle from the top of the hill.
Once, and twice.
One said: that is the alarm!
We must run!
The blind man said: we do not run!
The boy is close!
Search!
But the men did not listen to him.
They ran, each his own way.

sentences.ar: وضل الأعمى لحاله بنص الطريق، بيضرب بعصايته وبيصرخ عليهم.
sentences.en: And the blind man was left alone in the middle of the road, striking with his stick and screaming at them.

sentences.ar: وبهاللحظة سمعنا خيل جاية من التلة.
sentences.en: And in that moment we heard horses coming from the hill.

sentences.ar: كانوا جنود الجمارك، إجوا لأنه واحد من القرية بلغهم.
sentences.en: They were the customs officers, come because someone from the village had reported.

sentences.ar: الأعمى سمع الخيل، وارتبك، وركض للجهة الغلط.
sentences.en: The blind man heard the horses, panicked, and ran the wrong way.

sentences.ar: وقع تحت أول حصان، وما قام.
sentences.en: He fell under the first horse, and did not get up.

sentences.ar: طلعت من تحت الجسر، وناديت عالجنود.
sentences.en: I came out from under the bridge, and called to the officers.
I said: the papers are with me.
I must get them to Doctor Livesey.

sentences.ar: وركبت ورا واحد منهم، وطرنا بالليل.
sentences.en: And I climbed up behind one of them, and we flew through the night.
